run_bmm_grid: run the bmm_grid function to compute Triton program grid dimensions for batch matrix multiplication
create_bmm_template: create a TritonTemplate for batched matrix multiplication with configurable block sizes and L2-optimized program ordering
test_tuned_bmm: test the tuned_bmm function that registers a lowering for aten.bmm with autotuned algorithm selection
test_tuned_baddbmm: test the tuned_baddbmm function that performs batched matrix multiplication with scalar addition and epilogue
build_extern_kernel_choice: build ExternKernelChoice instances for aten_bmm and aten_baddbmm to bind PyTorch ops with output kernels
